arms_freeze.evolutionary_declaration: population = top-24 by scalar; per-dimension uniform crossover; mutation = one redrawn dimension with p=0.7
arms_freeze.matched_surface: every arm sees the same frozen shared history (measured raw vectors, no labels beyond registered coordinates), the same grammar, and the same per-wave quota; arms differ ONLY in how they choose
arms_freeze.qd_declaration: MAP-Elites over the frozen descriptor space; empty/rare cells targeted by a morphology prior; elite replaced only on strictly better declared scalar
arms_freeze.rng: per-arm sha256(master_salt|arm|generation|wave) -> random.Random; no wall-clock, no unseeded entropy
arms_freeze.scalar_objective: lexicographic (n - success, work), used only by scalar arms and elite replacement; the Pareto/admissibility machinery never collapses to it
arms_freeze.tpe_declaration: minimal Parzen estimator, gamma=0.25, eps=1e-3, draws = max(64, 32*quota), score = prod_dim (p_good+eps)/(p_bad+eps); stdlib only, no external library

campaign_bound.cycle_2_precondition: cycle 2 runs only at generation 3, i.e. only if cycle 1 ended DEVELOPMENT_CHANGE_ADOPTED
campaign_bound.exhaustion_terminal: a cycle whose 5 waves end with no winner closes that cycle with PARENT_SUFFICIENT_NO_ADOPTION or PARENT_SUFFICIENT_BY_REVIVAL_EXHAUSTION (per-wave failure_stage attribution + next-wave lever recorded); the programme then closes
campaign_bound.parent_array: once per generation, denominator registered on that generation's first wave
campaign_bound.wave_quotas: wave 1 quota=1 (smoke), waves 2-5 quota=12 per arm

denominators.registration: frozen per wave in manifests/BATCH.json BEFORE array submission
denominators.rule: compute inside the registered denominator is the point; compute outside it is a violation
denominators.smoke: wave 1 of generation 2 at quota=1 per arm: the harness-proof wave; it is INSIDE the freeze (its compute and its ledger rows count; nothing it observes is used to retune any frozen rule)

qd_freeze.canonical_lineage_invariant: the archive is a SELECTION organ only: the canonical lineage stays SERIAL, one adoption per generation cycle, never a population adoption
qd_freeze.descriptors_from: measured raw vectors + morphology dims, never the claimed objective

selection_rules_freeze.final_admissibility: every hostile in {PASS, NOT_APPLICABLE, ADVERSE_RECORDED}; any FAIL is inadmissible

selection_rules_freeze.preliminary_frontier: non-dominated on (failures, work, persistent_bytes) over admitted rows + the incumbent point
